wholePhysicalScope: Present shed footprint and long axis interpreted from open federal aerial imagery beside the state historical marker.
lodDetails: Four authored levels preserve the shed’s hipped roof, brick arches and wagon doorway.
limitations: This represents the restored water wagon shed. The dispersed historic district and other photographed, demolished or relocated post buildings are outside this structure.
Roof footprint comes from the original overhead image; elevation and façade layout, arched window spacing, door orientation and finish colors are approximate.
